name: Kali Remik
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Kali Remik guides young hunters toward their next training. She is a Darkspear troll hunter who knows the tracking and survival ways of Durotar.

sections.title: A Guide for the Hunt
sections.body: Kali Remik guides young scouts in Sen'jin Village, where they begin their lives beyond the Valley of Trials. A Darkspear troll tracker, she knows Durotar's dry lands and the Horde's settlements. When a novice is ready to leave the local training grounds, Kali sends promising hunters to Thotar in Razor Hill. There they begin learning to tame beasts, strengthening the Horde's frontier ranks.

faq.answer: Kali Remik is a Darkspear troll hunter and scout who guides young hunters ready to advance beyond local training.

faq.q: Where can Kali Remik be found?
faq.answer: Kali Remik can be found in Durotar, notably around Sen'jin Village, aiding her people.

faq.q: What guidance does she offer to hunters?
faq.answer: Kali Remik directs young orc and troll hunters who have proven their basic skills to Razor Hill. There, Thotar sets them on the path to taming a beast companion.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll hunter, you can look to Kali Remik for guidance when your skills outgrow village drills. She sends you to Thotar in Razor Hill.
As a Darkspear troll, you share Kali Remik's tribe. She watches over her kin as they rebuild their lives along Durotar's coast and settle in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
